subject.title: Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity

question: Should OpenClaw core recognize `openclaw-even-g2-node` with `platform: "even-hub"` and `deviceFamily: "glasses"` as a canonical native setup-code bootstrap client that receives the existing bounded operator handoff?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and tested, but it changes a Gateway auth trust boundary and settles a durable wire-level identity for an external glasses app; automation cannot choose that product/security contract.

options.title: Approve Narrow Identity After Rebase
options.body: Accept the proposed `openclaw-even-g2-node` / `even-hub` / `glasses` contract, require the conflict rebase, and keep app placement and command policy in the related product issue.

options.title: Rename Or Generalize First
options.body: Ask the contributor to switch to the maintainer-preferred durable id and refresh the external app/proof before merge.

options.title: Keep External For Now
options.body: Do not add a core bootstrap identity yet; keep Even Hub on generic node/plugin paths until maintainers choose a first-party or plugin ownership model.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Identity After Rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed `openclaw-even-g2-node` / `even-hub` / `glasses` contract, require the conflict rebase, and keep app placement and command policy in the related product issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway auth/protocol history makes this the strongest single routing candidate for the product and security-boundary choice.
